categories.main_business_segments: M&A Capital Partners operates a single business segment focused on M&A-related services, including M&A brokerage, advisory, database provision, and media operations. The group consists of the parent company and five consolidated subsidiaries, with core activities centered on supporting domestic M&A transactions, business succession, and corporate growth for unlisted and listed companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core capabilities lie in its accumulated M&A advisory know-how, a robust consultant training and knowledge-sharing system, and proprietary M&A databases. It leverages structured consulting processes, KPI-driven management, and high-quality advisory frameworks, supported by in-house developed business systems and a comprehensive M&A case database (MARRPro).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are domestic unlisted owner-managed companies, mid-sized and small businesses facing succession issues, and listed companies requiring complex M&A solutions such as TOB and carve-outs. The company also serves financial institutions, M&A boutiques, government agencies, and educational institutions through its database and media services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily focused on the Japanese market, with the vast majority of revenue and assets located domestically. While the group supports cross-border M&A, its main business activities and customer base are in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: M&A Capital Partners operates as a downstream service provider in the M&A value chain, directly interfacing with business owners, corporate clients, and institutional users to deliver advisory, brokerage, and information services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding market share in the business succession M&A market, strengthening consultant recruitment and training, and enhancing organizational infrastructure for quality and efficiency. The company emphasizes continuous consultant education, knowledge management, and the development of proprietary business systems and databases, but does not engage in traditional R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through success-based fees and advisory fees for M&A transactions. Additional revenue streams include subscription and licensing fees for M&A databases, media advertising, and educational seminar fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include major financial institutions, other M&A advisory firms, and new entrants from adjacent industries. The company differentiates itself through its extensive track record in large and complex deals, high-quality advisory services, and a strong brand reputation, positioning itself as a leading independent M&A advisory group in Japan.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated revenue was approximately 22.4 billion yen, with operating profit of 7.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to owners of 5.1 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth in both revenue and profit, with a 17.1% year-on-year increase in sales and a 12.4% increase in net profit, supported by rising deal volume and average transaction size.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: M&A Capital Partners emphasizes its ability to deliver high-quality, trustworthy, and sophisticated M&A advisory services, particularly for complex and large-scale transactions. Its value proposition is built on a proven track record, deep market knowledge, rigorous consultant training, and proprietary data assets, enabling differentiated, reliable support for business succession and corporate growth.
